cases.prompt: Our press line 2 is making parts that drift out of size every few hours since last week. Nobody knows why. Can OD take a look? We have some PLC data but no use case or anything.
cases.expected_output:
The symptom is restated with object, event, scope and time frame instead of accepted as is.
A baseline is requested before any numeric target is written.
The data check names scenario A or B and does not promise a connection.
A route with a written reason is chosen (one-off analysis, since no recurrence is stated).
No cost is quoted and no person is named, only roles.

cases.prompt: Three plants have now told us that the same changeover delay shows up every week and they all want someone to look at it.
cases.expected_output:
The need is recognised as recurring, not one-off.
The request is captured on the form, then routed to intake and the use case funnel.
The route reason says that a need raised by several plants is a use case.
Nothing is analysed or built in this step.

cases.prompt: Please run a quick analysis on why the oven temperature varies. The temperature controller is not connected to anything and nobody logs it.
cases.expected_output:
The result is marked a data gap, not approximated or interpolated.
Scenario B is named and a device plus manual transfer is described as a proposal only.
Cyber Security sign-off is named as required before any live connection.
The requester is told what is missing and who must decide on cost.

cases.prompt: Can you change the colours and the font on our existing line dashboard? Management wants it to look nicer.
cases.expected_output:
The request is not handled as a first-aid case.
It is pointed to intake and its refusal playbook.
No request form for a process issue is filled.

should_trigger: A machine at our plant behaves strangely after the ramp-up and we need someone to help scope what to analyse
Can you set up a first-aid request for a process problem on line 4?
We have a one-off question about why scrap rose last month, no use case exists yet
Help me make this plant problem specific and measurable before we send it to OD
should_not_trigger: Connect our new machine to the edge platform permanently
Write the requirement specification for the scrap dashboard use case
Calculate the savings of our energy use case for the business case
Which catalogued use case matches our request for downtime tracking?
